correctness.rationale: Exact coin-number shell counting gives the closed c_k(u) formula. For all q<=a, at most two shells contribute and their sum never exceeds p. In the q=a+1 block, the precise parity formula shows all odd-a indices exceed p; at even a exactly the odd remainders do not. At q=a+2 even a the entire block exceeds p, and the injection n->n+a propagates the result forever. This checks all quantifiers, boundary a=3, and every integer beyond the finite gap set. A separate dynamic-programming checker verifies a=3..160 and independently enumerates small triples; finite checks are corroboration only.
